content: लालन {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) Fondling, coaxing, caressing. .{@-नः@} A sort of poisonous mouse. .{@-नम्@} [लल्-ल्युट्] .²1 Caressing, fondling, coaxing; सुतलालनम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Indulging, over-indulgence, fondling too much; लालने बहवो दोषास्ताडने बहवो गुणाः; <ls>Pt. 1. 169</ls>; <ls>Bh. 2. 42</ls>.
